event.name: SC_BOARDER_MARINE
event.text: Enemy assault team approaching!

event.name: SC_BOARDER_FIRE
event.text: Need a light?

event.name: SC_BOARDER_GHOST
event.text: A team of specialists has been sent to collect the bounty on your head.

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_WRAITH_A
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_WRAITH_B
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_WRAITH_C
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_WRAITH_D
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_BATTLECRUISER_A
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_VESSEL_A
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_VESSEL_B
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_VESSEL_C
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_VESSEL_D
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN
event.text: "Stand down. We can transfer supplies if you let us limp out of here."
"You recieve a jumbled message from the heavily damaged ship. The remaining crew has surrendered and is requesting immediate aid."
"Fine, fine. Take the cargo. Just do not vent us into space."

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran ship breaks apart. You salvage what remains.

event.name: SC_ESCAPE_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran ship escaped.

event.name: SC_GOTAWAY_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran ship got away.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_TERRAN
event.text: With the crew neutralized, you search the Terran ship and secure its supplies.

event.name: DOMINION_SUPPLY
event.text: You discover a fully militarized Dominion station here, though it appears they are selling supplies to passing allied ships.
No one is safe from you. The Dominion will not be pleased when they hear of this.

event.name: DOMINION_SUPPLY_STATION_KILL
event.text: Your unprovoked, attack on a Dominion Station has been successful. You scrap what remains.

event.name: DOMINION_FREECREW
event.text: A damaged Dominion ship hails you. "Good, a friendly face for once. Our ship has taken catastrophic damage and there's no chance of repairing it. I don't suppose you'd be willing to allow me aboard? I'm handy with a wrench and I'm sure my skills could be of service to you."

choice.text: We don't need any more crew, sorry.

event.text: "Oh... ok. Hopefully I'll be able to keep the stabilizers under control so they don't collapse before another ship arrives to help..."
The civilian is thankful for your assistance.
As the crewman comes onto your ship, draws a laser and shoots at you. Luckily, no one is hit, but a ship bearing the markings of the Sons of Korhal uncloaks nearby and attacks. It was a trap!

event.name: DOMINION_AMMO
event.text: A Dominion station is sending out a request for ammunition, in return for scrap. Their high demand is likely due to the increasing number of blockades by the outlaws, the Sons of Korhal. They might be able to spare some blueprints if you are generous.

choice.text: Offer 5 missiles for whatever scrap they have.
Offer 10 missiles for a patch-up and some extra fuel.
Offer 20 missiles because the Sons of Korhal need to be stopped!

event.text: "Wow, are you serious? Thank you, your commitment to the cause will not be forgotten! The Dominion is grateful for your support."

choice.text: We don't have anything to sell.

event.name: DOMINION_KORHAL_CONTACT
event.text: A small Dominion ship is skulking far from the beacon. They seem to be waiting for someone.
The Dominion ship responds. "You're here for... business, aren't you?"
"Thought so. Let me tell them that the coast is clear." A moment later, a ship bearing the markings of the Sons of Korhal approaches.

choice.text: Threaten to report the Federation ship for being in cahoots with smugglers.

event.text: The Dominion captain quickly flies away. The smuggler angrily yells after the Dominion captain: "Damn you! You were supposed to protect us!"
"I must have you confused for someone else. Go on your way."
The smuggler puts his hands up. "Okay, okay! Let's not get hasty! Surely a discerning Renegade like yourself would be amenable to an understanding. Perhaps you see something you like in my stock?"

choice.text: Take a free legal weapon off their hands.

event.text: "You have no eye for quality, Renegade. Even so, we appreciate your discretion."
"You're as shrewd as you are reasonable, Renegade. Pleasure doing business with you."
"Then you leave me no choice! Prepare to die!"
The smuggler screams, "Narcs get what they deserve! Prepare to die!" Meanwhile, the Federation ship makes a hasty retreat.
The Federation warms its weapons up. "You think you can just threaten my career and get away with it? I'll never give in!"
The smuggler is nowhere to be found. You radio the nearest Federation base and let them know that there is a smuggler on the loose.
You chase down the smuggler. "You law-abiding Federation types are scary! Please don't kill us!" You escort the smuggler to the nearest Federation base, where you are rewarded.
No Sons of Korhal will be allowed to live so long as you can help it.
You have no interest in fighting with the Sons of Korhal.

textList.name: TEXT_DOMINION_KORHAL_CHOICE
textList.text: A ship bearing the markings of the Sons of Korhal is making minor repairs at this beacon, likely repairing the damage they took charging past the Dominion's borders. They will probably leave you alone if you do not engage them.
A nearby ship bearing the markings of the Sons of Korhal gives you a wide berth. They're looking to damage Federation supply lines, not pick a fight with you.
Some ships bearing the markings of the Sons of Korhal break through the outer defenses of the sector. This one is avoiding you, likely not wanting to endanger its mission.
The Sons of Korhal fleet that is chasing you through this sector might not be focusing all their attention on you. This ship seems preoccupied.

event.name: DOMINION_HANGAR_RAID
event.text: A large Dominion hangar has been built on the nearby planet. Any Domionion ship is allowed to dock.
You transmit your ID and not long after are allowed to enter. A repair team moves in to refuel your ship and make some repairs.

As you exit the hangar a blaring siren fills the air. A Sons of Korhal squadron is approaching! The planetary defense cannons are overwhelmed and most of the attacking ships are able to get past. A ship locks onto you and attacks!
It's tempting, but you can't waste any time.

event.name: DOMINION_ENCOUNTER_ELITE_STEALTH
event.text: The Dominion ship patrolling this beacon is no ordinary vessel. Its distinct shape marks it as part of the Federation's latest stealth fleet, created to help keep up with the never ending arms race with the Rebellion. Fortunately, they don't seem to object to your presence, but they aren't particularly welcoming either.
For some reason, you decide to open fire on an especially well-armed allied ship. They hardly hesitate to return the favor. Hopefully this will be worth it.

choice.text: Given your sketchy reputation, it's probably best to avoid making unnecessary requests from your allies.

event.text: "...Yes? We are currently not under any orders to provide aid to passing vessels. We can provide you with some additional fuel, but not much else."
Unsatisfied at their pitiful offer, you've decided to do whatever it takes to get more.
"...Yes? We are currently not under any orders to provide aid to passing vessels. Though given your contributions, we could probably make an exception for you. Just don't spend too long deciding."
Their patrol route soons takes them away from your ship, leaving you mostly alone here.

event.name: DOMINION_SHIP_STOLEN
event.text: A charred and smoking hangar resides at this beacon, barely functional. "We've been waiting for help to come by... we have truly awful news! A Dominion ship has been taken by the Sons of Korhal! Please, you have to do something! We have no idea what they're going to do with it, but whatever they are planning cannot happen!"
"We can still track their ship... fortunately we were not all killed in their escape. Please hurry!"
"Are you insane? The importance of this mission is... no, I'm sorry. I know your mission is important too. We will find somebody else."

event.name: DOMINION_SHIP_STOLEN_QUEST

beaconType.unvisitedTooltip: The Sons of Korhal have seized a Dominion ship, and it is currently at this beacon.

event.text: The occupied Dominion ship is approaching a Union station. But as soon as you move within sensor range, it disengages to face your ship instead!

event.name: ENCOUNTER_DOMINION_SALVAGE
event.text: You find the wreck of a Dominion ship nearby. Before you can even begin to consider salvaging it, another Federation ship jumps in. They demand an explanation for what happened.

choice.text: Tell them you didn't destroy this ship.

event.text: Your good reputation precedes you. Once they realize who you are, they apologize for the mix-up and offer to help you harvest the ship faster. Though not much remains, you find some usable equipment, and a small helping of scrap for your troubles.

choice.text: Tell them you didn't destroy this ship.
Tell them you didn't destroy this ship.

event.text: Whilst you try to convince them that they're mistaken, they don't seem inclined to believe you. "We've heard about all your misdeeds here! You really expect us to buy that you're not responsible?"

choice.text: Fight your way out of this.

event.text: You mute comms and prepare to fight them. Judging by how quickly they move to defend themselves, it seems this was what they expected you to do.

After a few moments of skepticism, the Dominion relents and lets you harvest the ship in peace. Though not much remains, you find some usable equipment, and a small helping of scrap for your troubles.

"Hmph. You're still taking the remains, you vulture." They back off, letting you harvest the ship. Though not much remains, you find some usable equipment, and a small helping of scrap for your troubles.
"Sorry about that. Some folks aren't so well behaved. I'll help you out." Though not much remains, you find some usable equipment, and a small helping of scrap for your troubles.

"Well, if you were responsible for this, I'm sure we'd already be fighting. Let me give you a hand." Though not much remains, you find some usable equipment, and a small helping of scrap for your troubles.
"A likely story! Word has it that some folks will harvest any ship unlucky enough to cross paths with them. You'll pay for this!"

event.name: ENCOUNTER_DOMINION_KORHAL_TAKEOVER
event.text: You receive an urgent hail from the nearby Dominion ship. "You have to help, the Sons of Korhal, they've taken over the ship!" The call suddenly goes to static and the ship turns hostile!

event.name: KORHAL_TAKEOVER_SURRENDER
event.text: The new "captain" of the ship hails you. "Alright, you've caused enough damage. Let us go, and we'll spare the last survivor of the original crew."

choice.text: The death of one more civilian is worth the death of even more Sons of Korhal.

event.name: KORHAL_TAKEOVER_DESTROY
event.text: You've destroyed the Dominion ship, and with it the Sons of Korhal and Dominion crew. You salvage what's left of the wreck.

event.name: KORHAL_TAKEOVER_DEADCREW
event.text: You've killed off all of the Sons of Korhal. As you salvage the ship, you notice the body of one of the old Dominion crew. You find they're still alive, and help them to their feet. After some washing and first-aid they're good as new and ready to serve on your ship.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL
event.text: Your ship arrives near the edge of a Terran patrol route. Sensor shadows flicker between nearby debris fields.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_1
event.text: Your sensors catch a faint Terran patrol signature before they fully lock onto you. You have a narrow chance to act first.

choice.text: Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You alter course and slip away before the patrol can confirm your position.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_2
event.text: Your improved sensors identify the patrol route before they spot you. You can choose the terms of engagement.

choice.text: Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You skirt the edge of their patrol route and continue undetected.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_3
event.text: Your advanced sensors resolve the patrol's course, weapon profile, and blind spots before they notice you.

choice.text: Ambush the patrol from their blind spot.
Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You pass cleanly through a gap in their sweep pattern.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_AMBUSH
event.text: Your sensors resolve the patrol's course before they notice you. You maneuver into position and spring the attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_FAIL
event.text: The patrol detects you first. A Terran ship turns toward your position, weapons charging as it moves to intercept.

choice.text: Push the engines and attempt to outrun the patrol.
Push the engines and attempt to outrun the patrol.
(Cloaking) Attempt to avoid the patrol under cloak.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_EVADE_SUCCESS
event.text: You divert power to evasive maneuvers and break away before the patrol can establish a firing solution.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_EVADE_FAILURE
event.text: You push the engines hard, but the patrol anticipates your course and cuts off your escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_CLOAK_SUCCESS
event.text: You cloak and drift beyond the patrol's search pattern. By the time your signature returns, the Terran ship is scanning the wrong part of the beacon.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_CLOAK_FAILURE
event.text: You cloak, but the patrol has already narrowed your position. They spread their search pattern and catch you as your cloak begins to fade.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_FIGHT
event.text: The patrol closes in before you can escape. You power your weapons and prepare for battle.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT
event.text: A Terran scout drops out of FTL almost on top of you. It catches your transponder signature before you can mask it and immediately turns to flee.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_STANDARD
event.text: You will have to act quickly if you want to stop the scout from escaping. If it gets away, it will warn the pursuing fleet.

choice.text: (FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
(External FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
Use Hacking to lock down the scout's engines.
Use Hacking to interfere with the scout's engines.
Try to hack the scout's engines.
Engage the scout before it can escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_PREIGNITER
event.text: You will have to act quickly if you want to stop the scout from escaping. If it gets away, it will warn the pursuing fleet.

choice.text: (FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
(External FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
Fire a precise volley at the scout's engines.
Fire a targeted volley at the scout's engines.
Try to hit the scout's engines before it can pull away.
Engage the scout before it can escape.
Use Hacking to lock down the scout's engines.
Use Hacking to interfere with the scout's engines.
Try to hack the scout's engines.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_WEAPON_SUCCESS
event.text: Your opening volley catches the scout before it can widen the gap. The shots rake across its engine housing.

triggeredEventBox.tooltip: The scout's damaged engines will recover in this amount of time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_WEAPON_FAILURE
event.text: You fire as the scout veers away, but the shot goes wide.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_HACKING_SUCCESS
event.text: Your hacking system breaks into the scout's drive control. Its engines lock into a diagnostic loop, buying you time to finish the fight.

triggeredEventBox.tooltip: The scout's engine lockdown will expire in this amount of time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_HACKING_FAILURE
event.text: You try to break into the scout's engine controls, but its emergency protocols reject the intrusion.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_FTL_JAMMER
event.text: Your FTL Jammer floods the scout's drive with interference. Its escape vector collapses before the ship can jump.

triggeredEventBox.tooltip: The scout's jammed engines will recover in this amount of time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_GOTAWAY
event.text: The scout jumps away before you can stop it. Moments later, encrypted fleet traffic spikes across the sector.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_FIGHT
event.text: The scout is already turning away, its FTL drive flaring hot. You power weapons and move to stop it.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_ENGINE_STATUS_CLEAR
event.text: The scout's engine systems recover from the disruption.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_DEAD_CREW
event.text: With the scout's crew neutralized, you search its databanks and secure its emergency supplies before any message can be sent. The ship's still-active comms buffer may contain a way to delay the pursuing fleet, but tampering with it could also expose your position.

choice.text: (Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Hacking) Attempt to break into the scout's comms buffer and falsify its final report.
(Hacking) Attempt to break into the scout's comms buffer and falsify its final report.
(Hacking) Attempt to break into the scout's comms buffer and falsify its final report.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_CREW_KILL_DELAY_SUCCESS
event.text: You alter the scout's final telemetry before it can be recovered. The pursuing fleet diverts toward a false trail, buying you time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_CREW_KILL_DELAY_FAILURE
event.text: The scout's comms buffer resists your attempt. The failed intrusion causes an emergency beacon to fire, giving the pursuing fleet a cleaner trail to follow.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_CREW_KILL_REWARD
event.text: You leave the scout's comms buffer alone and focus on stripping the ship before more Terran forces arrive.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT
event.text: A Terran assault group is already waiting at this beacon. Their lead ship moves to intercept, weapons hot and formation tight. This is not a scout or patrol trying to identify you; this is a direct attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT_FIGHT_1
event.text: The first Terran attacker breaks formation and opens fire. More contacts remain at the edge of sensor range.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT_SECOND_WAVE
event.text: As the first attacker falls back or breaks apart, a second Terran ship moves in to continue the assault. This one is committed to finishing the fight.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT_FIGHT_2
event.text: The second Terran assault ship advances and opens fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH
event.text: You arrive in a quiet stretch of space. The beacon appears empty at first glance: no distress calls, no obvious wreckage, and no active Terran signatures on your sensors.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_WARNED
event.text: One of your crew stiffens before the sensors catch anything. A hostile presence is waiting nearby, masked behind the quiet beacon traffic. You have a brief chance to act before the trap fully closes.

choice.text: Push the engines and try to escape the ambush.
Engage the exposed Terran ship before it can spring the trap.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_SPRUNG
event.text: The empty beacon suddenly comes alive. A Terran ship cuts power to its masking field and moves into attack position. You have only seconds to react.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_ENGINE_CHECK
event.text: Continue...

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_ESCAPE_SUCCESS
event.text: You slam power into the engines and break away before the Terran ship can fully close the trap.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_ESCAPE_FAILURE
event.text: You try to accelerate out of the kill zone, but the Terran ship anticipates your course and cuts off your escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_PILOT_CHECK
event.text: Continue...

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_PILOT_SUCCESS
event.text: Your pilot reacts instantly, rolling the ship clear of the main firing lane. The ambusher loses its perfect angle, forcing it into a more conventional engagement.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_PILOT_FAILURE
event.text: Your pilot tries to break away, but the Terran ship already has the vector covered. The ambush lands exactly as planned.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_NON_AMBUSH_FIGHT
event.text: Warned by your crew, you turn the trap against the Terran ship and force it into open combat.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT
event.text: You arrive near a heavily escorted Terran transport vessel. Its cargo holds are reinforced and its engines are already cycling up, but it has not jumped yet.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_FIGHT
event.text: The transport diverts power to its engines and attempts to flee as soon as you close in.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_GOTAWAY
event.text: The transport jumps away before you can stop it. Its FTL trail is unstable, but a strong sensor sweep might still recover its destination.

choice.text: Try to follow the transport's FTL trail.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_SURRENDER_TRACK
event.text: The transport powers down its weapons and transfers a cargo manifest fragment along with the surrender payment. The data may reveal where the rest of its convoy was headed.

choice.text: Use your sensors to analyze the transport's route data.
Take the scrap and move on.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_SENSORS_CHECK
event.text: Your crew scans the transport's residual jump data, looking for a usable destination.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_QUEST_SUCCESS
event.text: Your sensors isolate a clean jump vector from the transport's route data. You mark the destination on your map.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_QUEST_FAILURE
event.text: The transport's trail breaks apart before your sensors can resolve a destination. Whatever it was carrying is gone.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_QUEST
event.text: You arrive at the coordinates recovered from the transport's route data. The trail leads to a Terran logistics waypoint, but this event is still a stub and can be expanded into a follow-up fight, cache, or special reward later.
